scoring.frame_decision: midpoint within full audio UEM, final partial frame weighted by duration
scoring.shared_postprocessing: probability >0.5, no hysteresis, padding or minimum duration
scoring.production_postprocessing: pinned native default, separately scored; no tuning from this corpus
scoring.native_frame_rule: floor(N/160)+1; retain raw terminal frame and clip scoring to full-WAV UEM
scoring.fp32_frame_rule: floor(N/160); original pinned processor attention mask, including partial10ms input

exposure: Local tuning-heldout; ICSI Full/Vox dev+test declared training; AMI conditional official evaluation split only.
failure_policy: Retain every result. No threshold tuning, deletion, recording/channel/crop substitution after inference.
input_binding: Both Q8 processes hash actual normalized float32 little-endian PCM supplied to inference; one pass, checked against frozen WAV. FP32 metadata WAV SHA256 and installed environment/source commit are verified.
